messages:
Ava (AE): FYI MonetBank kickoff: they want EU-only inference + full subprocessor list + BYOK option. Can we confirm feasibility and a short cost delta for the quote?
Marco (Solutions Eng): Feasible. Quick Qs: do they require control plane in EU too or just inference/egress? BYOK via their HSM or Redwood-managed key?
Ava (AE): Customer said 'EU-only data path' and 'BYOK preferred'. No specific HSM named yet.
Jamal (Infra): Tech notes: tenant_pin -> workers pinned to eu-west-1, KV/cache kept local. This blocks cross-region autoscale; expect capacity uplift ~+15-30% depending on concurrency. Need IP allowlist, VPC peering or tenant connector, and cert rotation docs.
Priya (SalesOps): For quoting I need hosted+pin vs dedicated reserved numbers and any one-time BYOK onboarding fee.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Quick guidance: hosted+geo-pin = fastest POC but expect routing/egress surcharge ~+10-15% per-token and potential burst constraints. Dedicated reserved = +20-40% monthly commit but predictable unit cost and avoids most cross-region egress. BYOK/HSM = one-time integration & validation $4k-$6k + legal addendum.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Short customer blurb you can send:
"For strict EU residency we recommend either a hosted tenant-pin POC or Dedicated reserved capacity. Tenant-pin is fastest to deploy and keeps inference and egress in the EU, but may increase per-token cost due to constrained pooling. Dedicated gives predictable latency and economics for regulated workloads but requires a monthly commit and longer setup. BYOK/HSM is supported as an add-on and will require extra onboarding and a signed addendum."
LegalBot: Action items: attach subprocessors CSV, DPA link, SCCs, and SOC2. BYOK requires vendor compatibility check and signed addendum prior to provisioning.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Ops checklist to share with their infra team:
- Confirm EU region (eu-west-1) for inference workers and egress
- Decide control plane EU-only vs global
- Provide IP ranges + VPC peering/VPN details
- Confirm BYOK vendor and key exchange method
- Test cert rotation and key access flows
- Perf smoke tests: p95/p99 latency and token throughput targets
- Rollback/fallback policy (note: disabling fallback increases outage risk)
Jamal (Infra): POC infra recs: +2 g4dn-equivalent GPUs baseline and a KV-locality preflight. If they require no control-plane fallback, prepare incident runbook.
Priya (SalesOps): Timeline suggestion: Day 0 share docs + subprocessors; Day 3 infra handoff + whitelisting; Day 7 tenant-pin + BYOK test; Day 10 perf runs; Day 14 wrap + pricing decision. I'll draft hosted vs dedicated quote + BYOK line item and one-time onboarding fee.
Ava (AE): Great — send me the draft quote and the blurb; I'll forward to the customer. Thanks team :thumbsup:
